overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating LLMs' numerical reasoning capabilities for data-to-text generation tasks, particularly time-series interpretation. While it mentions data-to-text generation as the downstream application, the actual evaluation is on numerical reasoning tasks rather than actual text generation. The automatic evaluation uses Accuracy and F1 metrics on numerical outputs. No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge methods are used.
